item.title: Is there a consensus replacement for/improvement over R studio?
item.description: I recall seeing stuff on social media about this X months ago but I never got around to investigating if it was real or just AstroTurf. It's also been long enough that I've forgotten the name of the program. I mostly use RStudio for small bits of data analysis so I don't really feel a pressing need for an upgrade but I'm wondering if there's an obvious improvement I'm missing out on.
